name: rclone
description: Command-line program to manage files on cloud storage services with sync and backup capabilities

tools.description: Sync files and directories to/from cloud storage providers like Google Drive, S3, Dropbox, and 70+ others
tools.usage:
rclone copy /local/path remote:bucket # Copy files to cloud
rclone sync /local remote:folder --dry-run # Preview sync operations
rclone mount remote:bucket /mnt/cloud # Mount cloud storage
rclone serve webdav remote: --addr :8080 # WebDAV server
rclone config # Configure cloud providers
